verses.12:9: ٱقۡتُلُواْ يُوسُفَ أَوِ ٱطۡرَحُوهُ أَرۡضࣰ ا يَخۡلُ لَكُمۡ وَجۡهُ أَبِيكُمۡ وَتَكُونُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ قَوۡمࣰ ا صَٰلِحِينَ

meaning: The root TrH primarily means to cast, throw, or fling something, often implying it's done away with or discarded.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
